introduction: LAND is a fluid series of formal land animation experiments based on the imprint of the landscapes in various locations and intuitive interpretations of those movements. Shot in New York, Thimble Islands, Connecticut, Armstrong Redwoods, Sonoma County, California, Hastings, England. This is a new technique of time lapse animation created by artist and animator Eric Leiser. This is a pain staking technique that must be done in accordance with the time lapse requiring extreme physical and mental excursion.
